budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported a slight change in indirect costs of about $100.
budget_items.quote: there was a slight change in some of the indirect costs of public access and sewer enterprise but it was only around $100.

budget_items.topic: Community Project Funding requests to Rep. Lori Trahan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Requests were capped at $3M and must show a town match; the Flat Hill Culvert project already has an appropriation.
budget_items.quote: needed to no more than $3m and show that the town has matched a portion of the project
